== Clan Ranking Badges ==

Guild rankings in [https://animeadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Anime_Adventures_Wiki ''Anime Adventures''] are determined by your clan's total performance and are displayed through unique badges. Here’s a breakdown of the ranking system:

<center>
{| class="wikitable"
! Badge
! Ranking
! Description
|-
| [[File:Bronze.png|frameless|61x61px]] '''Bronze'''
| 50,000+
| Awarded to clans ranked at 50,000 or higher.
|-
| [[File:SilverGuild.png|frameless|60x60px]] '''Silver'''
| 49,999–26,000
| For clans ranked between 50,000 and 26,000.
|-
| [[File:GoldGuild.png|frameless|61x61px]] '''Gold'''
| 25,999–11,000
| Reserved for clans achieving ranks between 26,000 and 11,000.
|-
| [[File:PlatGuild.png|frameless|62x62px]] '''Plat'''
| 10,999-1,000
| Awarded to top-performing clans ranked between 11,000 and 1,000.
|-
| [[File:DiamondGuild.png|frameless|62x62px]] '''Diamond''' 
| 999–101
| Represents the highest-ranked clans, just short of the top 100.
|-
| [[File:MasterGuild.png|frameless|60x60px]] '''Master'''
| Top 100
| The ultimate badge, awarded to the top 100 clans in the global rankings.
|}
